name: Rider
source:
The servant of [url=/c3531]Matou Shinji[/url]. She is a selfish, greedy pirate, and wields pistols in combat.

[spoiler]Her true identity is the English sea captain Francis Drake, known to the Spaniards as the pirate El Draque. Her Noble Phantasm is called Golden Wild Hunt.[/spoiler]
